resources.string: Delete them from the cloud too
You can close this tab and go back to the app.

• **Chords named as they sound** With the capo counted in, chords, keys, scales, and tabs are named as they sound, and each diagram shows the fingered shape and its degree.
• **Preview songs before importing them** Read every song an import brings before anything is saved, from its preview or its review row, and tag all imported songs at once.
• **Tabs and chord grids redrawn** Tabs are drawn with joined strings and stay lined up when transposed, and chord grids show repeat counts such as x4 beside the chords.
• **Bold, italic, and underline** Lyrics and comments can have bold, italic, and underlined words, set from the editor's buttons or Ctrl / Cmd + B, I, and U.
• **More control over the PDF** The PDF export can leave out tablature, prints the capo and tempo you set, and can make a setlist's PDF only its running order.
• **Import ABC tunes** ABC files and pasted ABC text become songs with a chord grid; the tune is kept as text, since sheet music is not drawn yet.
